[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44620869/d3290420db99d263caa0daa2393c932299c6d7c0.png[/img]

[i][b]How to access the new Level 19?[/b][/i]

[spoiler]Level 19 can be accessed in two ways:

The first way is to select Level 19 from the menu in "Level Choose".

The second method requires you to first complete Level 974 - Kitty House. After completing Level 974, you will find yourself in the Laboratory. Behind you will be a secret door that leads to a new level.

To open the door and get a new tape, you need to find three hotel bells. 

They are scattered around the lab level and are not hard to find.

Once you find all three hotel bells, you need to go back to the door and pull the lever near the door, three lights should light up and the door will open.

Behind the open door you will find a new cassette tape. Then just take it and insert it into the cassette player.
[/spoiler]
